A '''troop carrier''' was a type of [[troop transport]]. The [[Iron Gauntlet Legion]] used a troop carrier to hunt down [[Galen Walton Erso|Galen Erso]] and [[Lyra Erso]] on [[Vallt]] after the [[planet]] joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Catalyst" /> ''[[Sempre]]'' was an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] troop carrier that was [[transport]]ing [[Wookiee]] [[Slavery|slaves]].<ref name="Thrawn" />
